body.message:
The listing is for the month of August, while your booking would start from the 26th onward, which is why the rates are different.

However, please allow me to check with our team and confirm whether we can offer you the rate of AED 8,000. The refundable security deposit would be AED 2,000.

Before confirming the booking, we kindly request our guests to complete a self viewing of the apartment first. Once the viewing is completed and you are satisfied with the unit, we can proceed with the payment and booking confirmation.

Thank you for your understanding.
